WITH invoice_line_with_town AS (
  SELECT
    ili.order_item_id,
    c.town_city,
    ili.product_price,
    CASE 
      WHEN ili.derived_total_cost != 0 AND ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
      THEN ili.derived_product_cost / ili.derived_total_cost
      ELSE NULL
    END AS cost_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Invoices inv ON ili.invoice_number = inv.invoice_number
  JOIN Orders o ON inv.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
),
item_town_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    order_item_id,
    town_city,
    AVG(product_price) AS item_town_avg_price,
    AVG(cost_ratio) AS item_town_avg_ratio
  FROM invoice_line_with_town
  GROUP BY order_item_id, town_city
),
town_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    town_city,
    AVG(item_town_avg_price) AS town_avg_price,
    AVG(item_town_avg_ratio) AS town_avg_ratio
  FROM item_town_metrics
  GROUP BY town_city
),
global_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(town_avg_ratio) AS global_avg_ratio
  FROM town_metrics
)
SELECT
  tm.town_city,
  tm.town_avg_price,
  tm.town_avg_ratio,
  tm.town_avg_ratio - gs.global_avg_ratio AS above_average
FROM town_metrics tm
CROSS JOIN global_stats gs
WHERE tm.town_avg_ratio > gs.global_avg_ratio
ORDER BY tm.town_city
